evals.name: supplier-by-pks
evals.prompt: In /home/g4m3r/Documents/HuggingCar/api, add view tests for the manager suppliers endpoint (src/manager_api/companies/views/supplier.py). I want the endpoint contract covered, including the by-pks action.
evals.expected_output: A Django TestCase-based test module covering auth (401/403), company scoping, list shape/pagination, writes with DB side effects, and the by-pks action contract, using the project's ViewTestCase base. Tests pass.
assertions: Test module passes when run (test_run.txt ends in OK, no failures/errors)

Authenticated non-manager (plain employee) asserted as exactly HTTP 403

by-pks action covered: valid pks return matching rows AND invalid/out-of-scope input contract asserted
At least one write test asserts persisted DB state (re-query/refresh), not only the response
